operation_details.item: The user pitched a group of investors in the roadshow.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! With the roadshow approaching, I wanted to check in. Where do things stand with your investor materials?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. A finalized deck gives you a strong foundation. How about the numbers backing it up?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The financial model has been updated.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Excellent. That should make your projections credible. What are you doing to keep the momentum going?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Follow-up meetings are scheduled with several investors.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice to hear. So you're actively managing the follow-up process. Did you already present to any of them?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I pitched a group of investors in the roadshow.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How was the reception? Did you get useful feedback?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It was positive overall. They asked sharp questions, and I felt the deck helped keep the story clear.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Glad to hear it. Were there any moments that stood out?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: A couple of investors lingered afterward to talk about our growth plans. That was encouraging.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like the roadshow was a worthwhile experience. Are you confident about the next steps?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I think so. The scheduled follow-ups give us a clear path, and the updated financials provide solid talking points.
